notes.title: Early Access Hotfix #10
Early Access Hotfix #09
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/83fc44181dd51036c7859f18ad4e22f777d5255d.png[/img]

[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where objects couldn't be picked up after their carrier have been killed;
[*]Fixed a bug where buttons would become unresponsive after finishing the tutorial and going back to the Main Menu;
[*]Fixed a bug that displayed pink artifacts when starting a new run after completing a previous one;
[*]Fixed a bug that would leave particles behind when swapping a relic for a catalyst;
[*]Added missing strings in credits.
[/list]

[h2][b]Bugs we are actively working on[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Working on a bug that sometime causes targeting to stop working on Eleanor;
[*]Working on a bug where followers would sometimes attack neutral ennemies unprovoked upon getting up;
[*] We are looking to fix an issue causing some UI elements to not appear when pressing ESC/Start during loading;
[*] We are looking at improving loading times in general;
[*] We are looking at a couple of more minor annoying bugs in the singleplayer experience.
[*] We are looking into a potential memory leak when leaving the game open for several hours.
[/list]


[h2][b]To be added to Worship's roadmap[/b][/h2]
[p]This new section will now list features and improvements that we are adding to our roadmap planning following player feedback and/or issues that the team judged worth tackling. Keep on telling us how you feel about the game and we'll do our best to focus on what the community is asking for! [/p]
[list]
[*](Community feedback) We heard the feedback regarding the save system and permadeath. We are looking at both short term and long terms improvements to address your issues in that regard.
[*](Community feedback) We are looking at improvements for the symbol recognition, but these might have to wait for the bigger updates planned in the roadmap.
[*](Community feedback) We will look at how we can add more gameplay differences and impact tied to the choice of god to Worship
[*](Community feedback) More resolutions and aspect ratio support
[/list]

[h3][b]Thank you for your patience fellow cultists![/b][/h3]
If you are wondering what we have planned for upcoming content, you can refer to our roadmap on Worship's store page!

- The Chasing Rats Team

notes.title: Early Access Hotfix #08
Shepherd of Horrors - Early Access update
notes.notes: [h1]Cultists, Rejoice![/h1][p]The first Worship update has been summoned and is [b]OUT NOW![/b] [/p][p]As promised on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1548180/view/518593488304996445?l=english"]Early Access roadmap[/url], also visible on the Store page, Shepherd of Horror is our first minor update to make its way into the game. We've been hard at work at not only fixing bugs, but also bringing exciting new content to the world of Worship. [/p][p]Asides from new upgrades/rituals and new things to encounter during your games, the update completely changes Hubryus' starting building, the Mutation Hatchery! This update also adds plenty of improvements to the summons and allies aspect of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/91ef9840dc1140bf11be9ed5bd5943f495b0e3b0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]New Content[/b][/h1][h2]Gods-related Cult Abilities Rework[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/dfcd77cd50e85a8833e4b6868a34ba33535b310e.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hubryus' Mutation Hatchery rework:[/p][list][*][p]You can now sacrifice your followers and fuse them in death to summon Folhorrors allies to fight battles for you. [/p][/*][*][p]Sacrified followers bodies no longer stay behind. Their flesh and blood is used in the making of your subservient abominations. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]An-Ansgaidh's "Berserk Followers" starting upgrade is replaced with the newly introduced "Mercy Killing" upgrade. Mercy Killing gives you some blood back as you offer corpses to your god using the Tribute ritual.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Upgrades & Rituals to acquire[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/c8a00a2b7e55475b8f831ba8bc20bff037eaa038.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ritual - Shadow leap[/h3][p]With this new ritual, you can leap to a nearby destination in immaterial shadow form while damaging every foes in your path. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/3cb0cb28fbf3bf17f1bb1ae70add7cd608265fe7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]New Ritual - Summon Rift Hydra[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/d11914eeadf7602d2e2ddc882e053ae32a6644d3.gif"][/img][/p][p]Invoke a mighty Rift Hydra, the apex predator from the Molewurm species. Legend says if you cut one head in the mortal realm, two regrow in the Unseen Depths and vice-versa. Unfortunately you don’t have a follower with shears at the ready in the other world.[/p][p][/p][h3]Ritual Passive - Noxious shapes[/h3][p]Fumes from the Unseen Depths now seeps into ritual shapes you cast, poisoning the nonbelievers that breathe this cursed air. Your god shall spare the faithful from the noxious effects, but you’ll have to endure the stench.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/7222cf8a4541a3a7488a9a0cb123756c39745f13.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Cultist Passive - Explosive Drinking[/h3][p]Syphoning blood now channels a growing explosion that detonates once you stop absorbing. The more blood absorbed, the deadliest the explosion gets. The perfect marriage of gluttony and wrath.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/8f378e0533c11db9e1624fe3a9a7adfe8e028244.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]An-Ansgaidh's Starting Upgrade - Mercy killing [/h3][p]Apostles of An-Ansgaidh are rewarded for their acts of mercy, notably freeing mortals from their painful existence. Offering corpses as tribute give cultists some blood back.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Encounters to spice up your exploration[/h2][list][*][p][b]A mysterious Kessessa themed puzzle encounter.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Eldritch Hatcheries to turn catalyst into a specific types, which can help cultists achieve their dream synergies.[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Akka blockades, standing their ground against the Last Church and holding precious godless prisoners.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We don't want to spoil all the fun for these so you'll have to scour the world while seeking devotion for you god to see what secret they hold![/p][p][/p][h2]New Enemy Variant[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0d6c1c19212c073c159b0055a9b0008f2fab1b37.gif"][/img][/p][h3]Inquisitor Variant - The Heretic Slayer[/h3][list][*][p]This elite variant of the inquisitor can pose a real threat to your cult, starting at the 2nd zone.[/p][/*][*][p]Be wary of his holy shockwave projectiles as well as his lunge combo attack that you should shieldbreak and cancel when you have the chance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Changes & Optimization[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Summons and other cultist allies have been improved in the following ways:[/p][list][*][p]Summons and allies now follow you as you head into a Test of Faith and when you are sent back to cult base. [/p][/*][*][p]You can now recall summons and allies to command them to disengage from combat for some time.[/p][/*][*][p]The amount of each summon you can command is now displayed in the ritual description section of grimoire when looking at summoning rituals.[/p][/*][*][p]If you try to summon more allies than your current limit, older summons above the cap are killed and new ones are summoned to take their place.[/p][/*][*][p]Killed summons no longer leave a corpse behind, and instead are burned away and returned to the Unseen Depths.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Interacting with an upgrade buildings will now open the ritual menu to display said upgrade's description[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted catalysts types' random rates to favor ritual catalysts a little bit more[/p][/*][*][p]A memory optimization that makes Worship considerably less memory hungry.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][p]We tackled a ton of issues in the past few weeks, as you might've noticed with the 7 hotfix patches we released since Worship's release into Early Access. That said, this update also contains its own considerable pile of fixed bugs! In rapid fire:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a navigation issue that made followers unable to path around some collisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed projectiles playing an impact feedback when colliding with allies.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented most instances of cultist being able to get to a unintended height.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visuals on tribute's VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some background scaling in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an invisible collision in the Untamed Borderlands.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed objects sometimes being impossible to lift or interact with, even with enough followers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controller issues that made the D-Pad Up close the grimoire menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with liftables' pathing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with followers audio and HUD counter when killed instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some errors in some displayed texts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed throw not working in certain contexts.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed summons/allies sometimes stacking on the same point.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI not showing up if menu input was pressed during loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a small visual asset on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Followers and allies are now able to properly path around upgrade monuments/buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an interaction with the cultist that sometimes soft-locked the player.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]Bugs we are actively working on[/b][/h2][list][*][p]We are looking at fixing objects being sometimes impossible to lift or interact with. We fixed this partially, as stated in the bug fix portion of the patch notes, but there are still some instances where this keeps on happening.[/p][/*][*][p]We are looking at improving loading times in general.[/p][/*][*][p]We are aware of an issue causing performance problems when swarming on destructible objects with a lot of followers.[/p][/*][*][p]We are looking at a couple of more minor annoying bugs in the single player experience. [/p][/*][/list][h2][b]To be added to Worship's roadmap[/b][/h2][p]This new section will now list features and improvements that we are adding to our roadmap planning following player feedback and/or issues that the team judged worth tackling. Keep on telling us how you feel about the game and we'll do our best to focus on what the community is asking for! [/p][list][*][p](Community feedback) We heard the feedback regarding the save system and permadeath. We are looking at both short term and long terms improvements to address your issues in that regard.[/p][/*][*][p](Community feedback) We are looking at improvements for the symbol recognition, but these might have to wait for the bigger updates planned in the roadmap.[/p][/*][*][p](Community feedback) We will look at how we can add more gameplay differences and impact tied to the choice of god to Worship.[/p][/*][*][p](Community feedback) More resolutions and aspect ratio support.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]What's Next?[/b][/h1][p]This content update is the first of many for Worship! We are actively reading your feedback, some of which we addressed in this update, some other we have planned in upcoming updates. The next big thing we have planned on the roadmap is a major update planned for Fall 2025:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2cdb1a394f6f27202f3ff21dc6f6c8aec36bb191.png"][/img][/p][p]Aside from the updates planned on the roadmap, we will continue fixing bugs and releasing hotfix patches to make the game increasingly more stable and eventually bug free.[/p][p][/p][p]Now, what are you waiting for? Don your robes, summon forth forces from the Unseen Depths and plunge the mortal world into madness.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Thank you all so much for delving into the world of Worship![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/99d6f538569a4d439f6881f049fa64971545c816.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]See you next time for a new update![/p][p] - The Chasing Rats team[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/b5dd353493d3b5e05eda80c06aec7ce97a61bde8.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/4e336eca7a18e1c3d651bc64b255363f87cc9b8e.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/0b107078298f1796e6130924a22b3f3031e44b90.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/800cae53c2c6c1b8cf6e6fc81f00fea92d4208d4.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/2d2fc1e54687ac88daec184991147802f8bb75c4.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/6fd6a4739e4388018394b57c387f6456cde84742.png"][/img] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/89a90a437dd62dd942d5f523138b87ceb3ad8eb7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update - Multiplayer, Save System and short term plan
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40035617/ce134a7eeb465e6925187028912d87ac959e4e96.png"][/img]Hello fellow cultists![/p][p][/p][p]A few days has passed since the early access launch and we already received an impressive amount of feedback from players. A lot of players were pretty vocal about their appreciation of the player fantasy, the originality of the game and its various mechanics. Although we’re truly grateful for the positive feedback the community has given us so far, we are also aware that there are parts of the game that need more support and that are not reaching both players’ and our own expectations.[/p][p] [/p][p]An important thing to consider while we are talking about the main issues surrounding the early access launch is that Chasing Rats Games is a small team. We have to prioritize our work towards the most important issues but we can’t tackle them all at the same time and some issues are more time consuming to address than others. Considering this, we want to be as transparent as possible with our players, since we consider this key to a successful Early Access development.  So it’s time to dive into those specific subjects and share our thoughts and plan of actions with the community.[/p][p][/p][h2]Save system[/h2][p]A lot of players have been vocal of their dissatisfaction regarding the save system in Worship. We’ve read every comment on Steam and Discord and we’ve noticed a misunderstanding regarding how the game saves.[/p][p][/p][p]The most common complaint we’ve received is the absence of a save system. To clarify things, there is a save system in Worship, auto-saving your progression at the beginning of every gameplay phase. Every time you reach the Test of Faith (boss fight) or get to a new zone to explore, your progress is saved. This means if you need to take a break during a play session of Worship, you can quit and get back to where you left off when you want. The source of the misunderstanding is probably due to the fact that you lose the progress you’ve made in a run when you die, as it’s commonly the case in roguelites. [/p][p][/p][p]Despite the presence or absence of the Save System, it is clear to us that the way saves and permadeath are handled in Worship in its current form is not meeting players expectations. For these reasons, we’ll take a step back to develop something closer to what players are asking us. We’ll make sure to update you on the subject as soon as we have a better idea of what we can implement and add to the updates planned on the roadmap. [/p][p][/p][h2]State of Multiplayer[/h2][p]We’ve been working day and night to make the online multiplayer functional for the early access release but, as a lot of players stated in the past 24 hours, the state of Worship’s multiplayer is unplayable. It is not up to the players, the Kickstarter backers and our own standards. For these reasons, we made the difficult decision to remove the multiplayer from the main game until we take the time to refactor our code base properly. As stated above, we cannot put our development effort everywhere at once, so in order to simultaneously bring new content updates planned on the roadmap as well as other improvements that you are asking for, we have to put some other things aside. We apologize for the inconvenience of this decision. The Multiplayer Support has been added to the backlog of the roadmap. The Steam page has also been updated for the time being to make sure we are not misleading players looking to join the cult.  [/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who still want to play multiplayer, even in its broken state, a Steam beta branch is available to everybody. The branch is called “beta-multiplayer” and should automatically be included in the Properties section of your game on Steam. [/p][p][/p][p]To access the Steam beta branches, follow these steps:
[/p][olist][*][p]Go to your Steam Library[/p][/*][*][p]Right click on Worship and then click “Properties”[/p][/*][*][p]In the Properties window, find the tab called “Betas”[/p][/*][*][p]In this section, you will find a rolldown menu which includes the “beta-multiplayer” branch. [/p][/*][*][p]By selecting the beta branch, your game will automatically update in your Steam library with the multiplayer available for you to play[/p][/*][*][p]To go back to the main version of Worship, select the “None” option in the rolldown menu[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]We’ll try to update the beta branch as often as we update the game, but keep in mind that some updates might be skipped for this version of the game and we will not be trying to fix the multiplayer issues in the branch until we’ve finished the refactors in the work for the main version of the game. 
[/p][p]We are aware of the frustration some of the players will have towards this decision, we hear you and we feel you. We’re the first to be disappointed when it comes to this, but it is important for us to create a good experience for our players and the multiplayer is just simply not there at the moment. It would not be respectful for players not to act on it and this was the only solution we could make in the short term. We’ll make sure to update the community when we have news regarding multiplayer, but consider this might take months to get there. [/p][p][/p][h2]Everything else[/h2][p]We know these aren’t the only issues Worship has at the moment. Some players voiced inconsistencies with the symbol recognition and several annoying bugs still remain. Please bear with us as we continue pushing hotfix patches while moving towards the updates planned on the roadmap. We are still on track for those, so we hope you are looking forward to the upcoming content and features![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and your enthusiasm towards Worship. Your feedback is valuable and our main and only priority is to make sure Worship develops into a positive experience for as many people as possible. [/p][p][/p][p]Expect news from us shortly and until then, godspeed everybody,  [/p][list][*][p]Alexis and the Chasing Rats team[/p][/*][/list]
